asks.name: type
asks.question:
QUESTION: What kind of document is this, and in which language is it written? The types are:
- bill: an invoice or bill that asks the reader to pay
- reminder_dunning: a payment reminder or dunning letter about an unpaid bill
- authority_tax: a letter or decision from an authority, tax office or public body
- health: a letter from a doctor, clinic or health insurer, such as an appointment
- insurance_contract: an insurance or service contract, or a change to its price or terms
- school: a letter from a school or kindergarten to parents
- receipt: a receipt or proof of a purchase
- info_no_action: an information letter or statement that asks nothing of the reader
- outgoing_letter: a letter the reader wrote and sent to someone else
- payment_proof: a confirmation that a payment was made
- other: anything that fits none of the other types
ANSWER FORMAT: TYPE LANGUAGE-CODE CONFIDENCE (for example: bill de HIGH)

asks.name: sender
asks.question:
QUESTION: Who wrote and sent this letter? Look at the letterhead, the sender line and the signature.
ANSWER FORMAT: ID KIND "name" CONFIDENCE, or NONE

asks.name: addressee
asks.question:
QUESTION: To whom is the letter addressed (the recipient in the address field)? If several people or parties are addressed together, list up to 3 separated by "; ", the main addressee first. RELATION is HOUSEHOLD when a family or household is addressed, GUARDIAN_OF when the addressee acts for another person the letter is about (for example the parents of a child), otherwise NONE.
ANSWER FORMAT: ID KIND RELATION "name" CONFIDENCE, or NONE
asks.answer: M10 PERSON HOUSEHOLD "Mustermann Consulting GmbH" HIGH

asks.name: subject_person
asks.question:
QUESTION: Who is the letter about, if that is a different person from the addressee (a patient, a child, the insured person)? If it is about several, list up to 3 separated by "; ". Answer NONE when it is about the addressee.
ANSWER FORMAT: ID KIND "name" CONFIDENCE, or NONE

asks.name: contact
asks.question:
QUESTION: Is a contact person named, or a person "for the attention of" or who handles the matter? Answer NONE when no one is.
ANSWER FORMAT: ID KIND "name" CONFIDENCE, or NONE

asks.name: care_of
asks.question:
QUESTION: Is the letter sent in care of someone: a person or household whose address is only used as a mailbox for the addressee ("c/o", "care of", "bei")? Answer NONE when it is not.
ANSWER FORMAT: ID KIND "name" CONFIDENCE, or NONE

asks.name: slot:letter_date
asks.question:
QUESTION: Which date is the date of the letter itself (when it was written or issued)? Not a deadline, a due date or an event.
ANSWER FORMAT: ID ROLE CONFIDENCE (ROLE is one of LETTER_DATE, DUE_DATE, DEADLINE, APPOINTMENT, EFFECTIVE_FROM, PERIOD, EVENT, OTHER), or NONE

asks.name: slot:total
asks.question:
QUESTION: Which amount is the main amount of this document: what the reader has to pay, or the total? Not a net or VAT part of it.
ANSWER FORMAT: ID ROLE CONFIDENCE (ROLE is one of TOTAL_DUE, NET, VAT, GROSS, INSTALMENT, ADVANCE, FEE, CREDIT, PREVIOUS, OTHER), or NONE

asks.name: slot:due_date
asks.question:
QUESTION: By which date must the reader pay or act? If the letter gives only a period in words (for example "within 14 days"), answer RULE and copy those words exactly.
ANSWER FORMAT: ID ROLE CONFIDENCE, or RULE "words" ROLE CONFIDENCE (ROLE is one of LETTER_DATE, DUE_DATE, DEADLINE, APPOINTMENT, EFFECTIVE_FROM, PERIOD, EVENT, OTHER), or NONE

asks.name: slot:iban
asks.question:
QUESTION: Which IBAN is the account the reader should pay to?
ANSWER FORMAT: ID CONFIDENCE, or NONE

asks.name: slot:reference
asks.question:

asks.name: slot:customer_no
asks.question:

asks.name: slot:new_amount

asks.name: slot:previous_amount

asks.name: extras
asks.question:
QUESTION: List up to 6 other important facts of this letter that the earlier questions did not cover (a meter number, a tariff, a policy holder, a vehicle plate, a school class, a phone number to call ...). Separate the facts with "; ". Answer NONE when there are none. Use only ids that were not answered before.
ANSWER FORMAT: ID "label as printed" english_key "value copied from the letter, empty when an id is given" CONFIDENCE, or NONE "label" english_key "value" CONFIDENCE when no id fits

asks.question:

asks.name: text:summary
